# Thornacre Alloys - furnace controller workload

The controller image is published under a tag that the release job overwrites on every build.
The pod spec fields the platform team uses are carded in manifests/pull-policy-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Thornacre Alloys publishes its furnace controller image under a tag that the release job overwrites in place. Give the field and its value in the pod spec that make the node agent ask the registry again every time a container from that image starts, instead of starting from the copy it already holds. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
